prompt: In a photorealistic photo of a bustling pottery workshop, the scene is densely packed with activity and distinct elements. On the left side, a woman in a blue apron sits on a wooden stool, her hands covered in wet gray clay as she centers a spinning lump on a kick wheel. Next to her stands a tall man in a yellow shirt, who is pointing at the wheel's mechanism while holding a metal rib tool. A small orange cat rests on a shelf directly above them, watching the motion with narrowed eyes. In the center of the room, an elderly man with white hair leans over a workbench, carefully painting a delicate floral pattern onto a bisque-fired vase. Beside him, a young girl in a pink dress looks at the vase with wide curiosity, her hand reaching out tentatively toward the glaze pots. A large brown dog lies on the concrete floor near the girl’s feet, sleeping soundly amidst scattered tools. To the right, a teenager in a black hoodie carries a heavy stack of greenware plates, walking carefully past a rack of drying bowls. Standing next to the rack is a woman in a green scarf, who is handing a sponge to a boy in a striped shirt. The boy takes the sponge and wipes dust from a nearby kiln controller panel. On the far right wall, a bearded man in overalls hangs up a finished teal mug on a pegboard filled with various wooden modeling tools. A silver bucket sits on the floor near the kiln, reflecting the ambient light. A potted fern rests on a high windowsill in the background, adding a touch of nature to the industrial space. There is no digital screen displaying data. There is no coffee cup on any surface.
